key_insight: Bi-FORK learns one-to-many physical solution maps for symmetry-breaking bifurcations, generating multiple valid high-dimensional trajectories instead of a single surrogate prediction.
engineering_relevance: This enables scalable surrogate modeling for nonlinear engineering and physical systems where bifurcations produce multiple stable outcomes, such as buckling, metamaterials, and phase separation.
method: Latent flow matching generates full space-time trajectories with coherence preserved across points and time.
Repulsion-guided sampling encourages distinct solution branches in one amortized inference pass.
Designed for high-dimensional bifurcating systems with multimodal outputs rather than deterministic mappings.
evidence_signal: The paper evaluates Bi-FORK on buckling beams, mechanical metamaterials, and Allen-Cahn phase separation, including discretizations up to 260,000 points, and reports recovery of multimodal solution structure at scale.
watch_item: Repulsion-based branch separation may be sensitive to hyperparameter tuning and may require careful validation to ensure all physically valid modes are captured without introducing artifacts.
paper_title: Bi-FORK: Generative Modeling of High-Dimensional Bifurcating Systems
